signals.title: Uber Stock Retail Trading Signal Dashboard
signals.subtitle: Spikes in 'uber stock' searches indicate retail investor interest outpacing institutional coverage. Build a real-time dashboard that tracks Uber's price action, news sentiment, and options flow specifically for retail traders. The product can monetize through subscriptions, sponsored alerts, or affiliate brokerage links, filling a gap for accessible, focused equities data.
